hypothesis: If CURE-DPO's advantage over Recovery SFT were only the lower-tail state selection, then Recovery SFT given the same lower-tail selection would close most of the gap. If a substantial CURE - Tail-SFT gap remains, the pairwise ranking objective contributes beyond aggregation.

selection.note: loss_topk = the honest 'SFT with lower-tail selection' cell. replay_indices additionally removes the 'different states chosen' degree of freedom by replaying the matched CURE-DPO run's per-step state ids; run it as a secondary check if the selection log is available.

anchors.note: Same anchor weights as the CURE-DPO recipe (paper Section 4.4).

optimization.note: Set max_steps to the SAME optimizer-step budget the matched CURE-DPO run used; 0 is a placeholder that must be filled from the training config before locking. LR 8e-7 is the development-selected value from the paper.

statistics.primary: paired CURE-DPO - Tail-Recovery-SFT on S1 and S3
statistics.multiplicity: Holm across the S1 and S3 contrasts

decision_rule.objective_contributes: CURE - Tail-SFT on S1 excludes 0 after Holm
decision_rule.if_gap_closes: attribute the gain primarily to lower-tail selection and revise the paper's wording; report this outcome even though it weakens the objective claim
decision_rule.seed_reporting: if only one seed is finished by the deadline, label it 'single seed; three-seed replication in camera-ready' and do not present a seed SD
